name: Search Fusion
description: Federated web search fusion for OpenClaw that reuses configured providers in parallel.

webSearch.label: Search Fusion web_search provider
webSearch.help: Declares that this plugin participates in OpenClaw web_search provider discovery.

defaultMode.description: Optional default mode name to use when a request omits both providers and mode. Resolves against custom modes, or built-in starter modes when custom modes are absent.

modes.description: User-defined mode map. Each key is a mode name and each value is a provider id list. When omitted, starter modes are auto-generated: fast (1 provider), balanced (2 providers), deep (all providers).

intentProviders.description: Provider lists keyed by intent hint (research, keyword, answer, news, local). Used when a request carries an intent but no explicit providers or mode. Built-in keyword routing selects classic results providers without answer synthesis. Local has no built-in preference and falls through unless local is configured here.

research.description: Providers to use for research/in-depth queries (e.g. exa, parallel, tavily).

keyword.description: Providers to use for keyword/classic web searches (e.g. brave, duckduckgo, minimax).

answer.description: Providers to use for direct-answer queries (e.g. codex, gemini, grok, kimi, perplexity).

news.description: Providers to use for news/current-events queries (e.g. brave).

local.description: Optional explicit providers for location-aware queries. OpenClaw 2026.7.2 has no provider with verified local strength through the generic web_search path.

defaultProviders.description: Backward-compatible fallback provider ids when a request omits both providers and mode.

excludeProviders.description: Provider ids excluded from intent/default fallback selection. Explicit providers and explicit modes may still select them.

sourceTierMode.description: Source-tier reranking policy. off disables tier adjustments, balanced downranks lower-trust classes, strict applies stronger suppression.

countPerProvider.description: Optional shared default number of results requested from each provider. When omitted, each provider uses its native maximum; values are clamped to the provider's configured and native maxima.

maxMergedResults.description: Maximum merged results returned by the broker.

totalTimeoutMs.description: Whole fan-out deadline including credential preparation, retries, and backoff. Defaults to 30000ms; completed providers are returned as partial results.

includeRawPayloads.description: Include full provider payloads, complete normalized provider runs, duplicate merged evidence, and detailed dropped-result records. Defaults to false.

includeDiscarded.description: Include items discarded from merging (missing URL, or a URL that is not http(s)). Defaults to false.

maxSnippetLength.description: Maximum model-visible length for result, variant, and evidence snippets. Defaults to 500; truncated fields are marked.

maxAnswerLength.description: Maximum model-visible length for provider answer digests (answers[].fullContent). Defaults to the larger of 2000 and maxSnippetLength; truncated answers are marked.

fuzzyDedupe.description: Enable conservative fuzzy URL and same-host normalized-title deduplication. By default it activates only when more than one provider contributes results; true forces it for single-provider runs, false retains exact canonical-URL merging only.

trackingParams.description: Tracking parameter names or prefix patterns ending in * to add to, or replace, the default fuzzy-dedupe tracking list.

trackingParamMode.description: Whether trackingParams extends the safe default list (default) or replaces it entirely.

retry.description: Global retry policy for provider calls. maxAttempts is total attempts including the first try.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts per provider call, including the first try. Defaults to 3.

backoffMs.description: Initial retry backoff in milliseconds. Defaults to 750.

backoffMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to each subsequent retry backoff. Defaults to 2.

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum retry backoff delay in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

providerConfig.description: Per-provider overrides keyed by provider id.

count.description: Legacy default result count for this provider when the request does not pass an explicit count. Prefer maxResults as the provider ceiling.

maxResults.description: Maximum results requested from this provider. Defaults to the delegated adapter's native maximum and can lower, but never raise, that maximum.

weight.description: Ranking score multiplier for this provider. 1 is neutral, higher values trust this provider more, and lower values down-weight it.

scoreCalibration.description: Native relevance-score calibration for this provider. Defaults to minmax within each result set. Minmax uses 1/rawRank for constant or singleton sets, and every strategy uses that fallback for missing or invalid scores.

strategy.description: minmax scales this result set to [0,1], rank uses 1/rawRank, fixed applies the configured piecewise-linear curve, and none passes native scores through clamped to [0,1].

curve.description: Fixed calibration points. Inputs must be strictly increasing; outputs must be non-decreasing from 0 to 1. Values between points are linearly interpolated and values outside the curve use the nearest endpoint.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts for this provider, including the first try.

backoffMs.description: Initial retry backoff for this provider in milliseconds.

backoffMultiplier.description: Retry backoff multiplier for this provider.

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum retry backoff for this provider in milliseconds.

providerRetries.description: Deprecated alias for per-provider retry overrides. Prefer providerConfig.<provider>.retry.

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts for this provider, including the first try.

backoffMs.description: Initial retry backoff for this provider in milliseconds.

backoffMultiplier.description: Retry backoff multiplier for this provider.

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum retry backoff for this provider in milliseconds.

rankingStrategy.description: Merged ranking. score (default) keeps the calibrated merged-score-v1 ranking; rrf uses weighted reciprocal-rank fusion (rrf-v1), so agreement between providers lifts a result without trusting any provider's native score scale.

rrfK.description: RRF damping constant used when rankingStrategy is rrf. Lower values reward top ranks more. Defaults to 60.

circuitBreaker.description: Cross-call provider health. A provider that keeps failing is skipped for a cooling-off window so a dead source cannot add its timeout and retries to every search. Enabled by default.

hardFailureThreshold.description: Consecutive hard failures (auth, billing, plan entitlement, connection refused) that open the circuit. Defaults to 1.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive other failures (timeouts, 5xx, empty errors) that open the circuit. Defaults to 3.

cooldownMs.description: First open window in ms; doubles on each re-open up to maxCooldownMs. Defaults to 300000.

maxCooldownMs.description: Upper bound for the open window in ms. Defaults to 3600000.

readPages.description: Read the top merged result pages through OpenClaw's SSRF-guarded fetch and attach the passages that best match the query (results[].passages), so one search call carries the facts, not just snippets. Off by default; per-page failures keep the provider snippet.

topK.description: Merged results to read, best first. Defaults to 4.

timeoutMs.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole read step, also capped by totalTimeoutMs. Defaults to 4000.

maxPassages.description: Passages kept per page. Defaults to 3.

passageChars.description: Target passage length in characters. Defaults to 600.

maxBytes.description: Response body cap per page in bytes. Defaults to 1500000.

skipDomains.description: Hosts (and subdomains) never fetched. Defaults to video and social sites.
